rationale: Repair only the two proven PRE-Q8 controller defects. First, expose the exact controller-owned Python target execution contract (pytest, compileall src tests, ruff src tests and admitted toolchain capabilities) as trusted evidence and binding decisions to the external-product planning roles and Builder; when these fixed gates are attached, deterministically guarantee each external implementation contract can write src/** and tests/**. Do not weaken or replace any gate and do not claim support for Go or another unavailable toolchain. Second, expose the exact remaining Path Governor execution slots to the Replanner and make PlanCompiler reject a fresh recovery delta wider than that remaining budget as a precise PlanContractViolation before outcome commit. Retain the atomic reserve_execution_slots guard for races, but map its exhaustion to a typed path-governor failure rather than controller_exception_value_error or unknown_reason_code. Add focused regressions reproducing the accepted Go/Python mismatch, missing tests/** scope, a four-slice proposal with two remaining slots, atomic rollback and typed classification. Use the VPS GitHub broker for publication and strict-squash merge. Request EIGHT and epoch RE-9F1C4D25D86BAE1D93126C42 are immutable and non-retryable; only a fresh merged main commit may be submitted once as request NINE. Do not touch Stable, systemd, brokers, credentials, Telegram, PR 173 or any runtime database, and do not use danger-full-access.
